title: Transcription processes compete with loop extrusion to homogenize promoter and enhancer dynamics.
authors: Platania, Angeliki; Erb, Cathie; Barbieri, Mariano; Molcrette, Bastien; Grandgirard, Erwan; de Kort, Marit A C; Pomp, Wim; Meaburn, Karen; Taylor, Tiegh; Shchuka, Virlana M; Kocanova, Silvia; Nazarova, Mariia; Oliveira, Guilherme Monteiro; Mitchell, Jennifer A; Soutoglou, Evi; Lenstra, Tineke L; Molina, Nacho; Papantonis, Argyris; Bystricky, Kerstin; Sexton, Tom
one_liner_zh: 该文结合活细胞成像与分子动力学模拟研究Sox2基因增强子-启动子动态，聚焦染色质环挤压与转录竞争，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA结合特异性建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA动态机制研究。
abstract: The spatiotemporal configuration of genes with distal regulatory elements is believed to be crucial for transcriptional control, but full mechanistic understanding is lacking. We combine simultaneous live tracking of pairs of genomic loci and nascent transcripts with molecular dynamics simulations to assess the Sox2 gene and its enhancer. We find that both loci exhibit more constrained mobility than control sequences due to stalled cohesin at CCCTC-binding factor sites. Strikingly, enhancer mobility becomes constrained on transcriptional firing, homogenizing its dynamics with the gene promoter, suggestive of their cotranscriptional sharing of a nuclear microenvironment. Furthermore, we find transcription and loop extrusion to be antagonistic processes constraining regulatory loci. These findings indicate that modulating chromatin mobility can be an additional, underestimated means for effective gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 基因与远端调控元件的时空构型被认为对转录控制至关重要，但其完整机制尚缺乏理解。我们结合基因组位点对和新生转录本的同时活体追踪与分子动力学模拟，评估Sox2基因及其增强子。我们发现，由于停滞的黏连蛋白在CCCTC结合因子位点上的作用，这两个位点表现出比对照序列更受限的移动性。引人注目的是，增强子的移动性在转录启动时受到限制，使其动态与基因启动子趋于一致，暗示它们共转录共享核微环境。此外，我们发现转录和环挤压是限制调控位点的拮抗过程。这些发现表明，调节染色质移动性可能是有效基因调控中一个额外且被低估的手段。
